title: UFUND × COM7 Attach Rate Analytics
headline: Connecting the branches of a business.
summary: Monthly branch-level reporting that connects multiple data sources into a view of attach-rate performance.
tools: Power BI, SQL Server, Power Query, Excel
coverNote: Project description based on Sofwan’s resume. The cover illustrates the data relationship and contains no internal business figures.

blocks.html:
The question

How can attach-rate performance be compared across business units, branches, brands and partners?

The approach

Combine monthly branch data from several SQL Server sources with an Excel business-unit master. Prepare consistent views of units and revenue.

What it enables

Comparisons by business unit and brand, including Apple/non-Apple and partner views, using a connected reporting structure.
